title: Port tenant list/detail with scoped filters, access management, suspension, and quota links

commands.result: passed: 1 test using supervised production server and system Chrome

assertions: TenantDirectory uses canonical tenant IDs and deterministic scoped data.
Table and card views, search/state filters, detail drawer, activity links, Jobs/Billing/Audit links, role-safe access UI, and confirmed suspension flow are implemented.
Viewer mutation controls are disabled with an accessible reason; suspension requires tenant confirmation and a non-empty reason.
The focused E2E collects source IDs across table, row menu, card, detail, access, and suspension surfaces and asserts exactly the unique set admin_tenants:1 through admin_tenants:23.
No private media paths, payment data, raw API errors, dead hrefs, or placeholder markers were found in changed tenant files.
verification_notes: The focused E2E covers search, card view, detail drawer/deep links, viewer-disabled access, allowed role assignment messaging, and confirmed suspension messaging. Build emitted the repository's existing autoprefixer warning for flex-end compatibility.
